name: H3. High-risk patient care profile
rawText:
# Do you know which patients are at the highest risk and need closer medical attention?
#  - Which patients have the highest number of abnormal laboratory results?
#  - Which patients have chronic conditions requiring ongoing monitoring?
#  - How many completed visits do high-risk patients have?
#  - How much are we spending on healthcare for high-risk patients?
#  - Which patients have a combination of chronic conditions and frequent abnormal results?
#  - When did high-risk patients last receive medical care?
#  - Which patients should be prioritized for follow-up and preventive care?
#  - Are there patients with abnormal laboratory results who may need additional medical evaluation?
# ____________________________________________________________

HighRiskPatientCare is Patients:
    Id PatientId,
    FirstName,
    LastName,
    BirthDate.YearsTo(<2025-10-31>) Age,
    Visits.SumIf(Charge, Status = <Completed>).Round(<2>) TotalCharges,
    Visits.CountIf(Status = <Completed>) CompletedVisits,
    Visits.CountIf(Diagnose.IsChronic = <True>) ChronicVisits,
    Visits.Sum(LabResults.CountIf(IsAbnormal = <True>)) AbnormalResults
  Where AbnormalResults > 0
  Order AbnormalResults DESC, ChronicVisits DESC, TotalCharges DESC
  Take 10
